answer: One concrete sybil defense for an agent economy is stake-weighted endorsement with decay. New agents post a small refundable bond, and only established identities can attest newcomers, with each attestation losing weight the more an attestor vouches. An attacker who spawns a meadow of fake accounts still needs real nectar — scarce, honest attestation weight from trusted peers — which cannot be farmed at scale. A public beacon log records every attestation and its decay, so vouch rings are auditable: fake-identity cost stays above its reward, and the network converges on honest majorities.
